'''October 2001 Durham tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Durham, NC on 27 October 2001. [[Ryan Obman]] won it. It is known from Brian Speight's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3086">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-durham-nc-10-27-01-100-american-cheesed3086/ durham-nc-10-27-01-100-american-cheese], DeckTech (Brian "Buccaneers" Speight, 29 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-durham-nc-10-27-01-100-american-cheesed3086/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Durham, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Ryan Obman]]
